source: the raw records of the runners of GitHub, judged again with the catalog after the calibration of the propagation

cells.name: iptables, the propagation of a deletion, preStop 10 s

prediction.text: This cell is a calibration. A preStop sleep of 10 s keeps the pod open while the deletion propagates, thus no request fails. Each node gives its propagation: the time from the deletion to the first poll of its rules without the pod.

cells.why: The calibration measured the propagation in each of the 11 counted runs.

prediction.text: The algebra predicts that no request fails.

cells.name: iptables, pod deletion, no hold and no preStop

prediction.text: The algebra predicts that each failed request starts in a window. The window opens at the stop of the intake, and it closes 0 s to 105 ms after the deletion of the pod.
